group_assessment.weighting: Medical University of Lodz, senior author Bednarek. Independent of both the Aqeilan (Hebrew University) and Chang/Hsu (NCKU) lineages, and WWOX is nearly half its output. Full weight on the measurements; the laboratory is a WWOX laboratory, not a diabetes laboratory, and its system is a skin fibroblast line.

queries.query: WWOX is the manipulated variable in this paper

field_density.note: Maximum density: WWOX is both subject and manipulated variable, in two directions.

multihop.enumeration_method: The body cites to [127]. The MDPI JATS deposit carries the reference list, but this reading did not dereference it; the two load-bearing WWOX antecedents are the authors' own gestational-diabetes study [50] and Abu-Remaileh's HIF1A work [26].

corpus_crossquery.query: What does the corpus already assert about this paper, and does any of it misreport what the paper measured?
corpus_crossquery.finding: PAPER 023 records 'Model/species: mixed mechanistic / non-CNS direct' and 'Genotype/model: WWOX downregulation framework', and carries no evidence-depth line although a partial receipt has stood since 2026-09-21. Both fields are vaguer than the paper: the system is ONE immortalised human skin fibroblast line (1BR.3.N, ECACC 90020508) under four crossed sugar/oxygen conditions, the loss-of-function arm is a CRISPR/Cas9 polyclonal knockdown the paper itself calls KO (about three-fold lower mRNA), and there is a second arm — lentiviral WWOX cDNA overexpression at about 850-fold mRNA — that no registry record mentions at all. CLAIM 009 cites the paper for a redox/energetics inference and is not touched by this reading.

verbatim_locators.source_fulltext_indexed_evidence: JATS from the Europe PMC fullTextXML endpoint for PMC8955937, 232616 bytes; every locator is matched against it by deepdive_manifest.py --verify-artifacts.
verbatim_locators.abstract_anchoring_waived: No locator draws on the abstract. PubMed's abstract for this record is itself defective — the typesetter's italic deletion removes the gene names, leaving 'The axis Downregulation' — which is one more reason every quote here comes from the body.
verbatim_locators.note: Coverage: abstract, introduction, all Results sections, Discussion, Conclusions, Materials and Methods, and all twelve figure legends in the JATS. Figure panels were NOT inspected as images and the supplementary figures S1-S6 could not be fetched (Europe PMC supplementaryFiles returns HTTP 500 for PMC8955937), so every statement about the overexpression arm rests on running text that carries its own numbers. The reading is partial for both reasons.

entries.proposition: THE LOSS-OF-FUNCTION ARM IS A PARTIAL DEPLETION THAT THE PAPER CALLS KO THROUGHOUT. Any claim inheriting the word knockout from this paper inherits about a three-fold mRNA reduction in a polyclonal population, not a null.
entries.snippet: The relative expression level of WWOX mRNA was three times lower in 1BR.3.N WWOX KO variant in comparison to CONTR, and 850 times higher in 1BR.3.N WWOX OE than WT.

experimental_context.genotype: CRISPR/Cas9 sgRNA knockdown (called KO) and lentiviral WWOX cDNA overexpression
experimental_context.comparator: scrambled sgRNA control and empty-vector wild type

entries.proposition: GLUCOSE UPTAKE DOES NOT MOVE MONOTONICALLY WITH WWOX DOSE: THE SIGN OF THE LOSS-OF-FUNCTION EFFECT REVERSES BETWEEN CONDITIONS. A carrier-detectable uptake readout cannot be specified without naming the oxygen and glucose condition.
entries.snippet: We observed that WWOX silencing significantly increased glucose uptake in normoxia normoglycemia and reduced glucose uptake in hypoxia hyperglycemia conditions in the absence of insulin.
entries.anchor: Results 2.3 WWOX Depending Glucose Uptake, first paragraph

experimental_context.treatment: 5.5 or 25 mM glucose, 19% or 1% O2, 48 h, with and without 1 microM insulin
experimental_context.comparator: scrambled sgRNA control in the same condition

entries.proposition: THE RE-SUPPLY ARM DOES NOT RESTORE THE LACTATE ENDPOINT — IT RAISES IT IN TWO OF THE FOUR CONDITIONS. Lactate is therefore not a dose-faithful readout of WWOX in this system, and a re-supply programme cannot assume the loss-of-function direction simply inverts.
entries.snippet: Lactate concentration were significantly higher in case of WWOX overexpression in comparison to 1BR.3.N WT cell line in normoxia normoglycemia and hypoxia hyperglycemia
entries.anchor: Results 2.5, final paragraph on the overexpression variant

experimental_context.genotype: WWOX cDNA overexpression versus empty-vector wild type
experimental_context.comparator: empty-vector wild type in the same condition

entries.proposition: THE OXIDATIVE ARM WAS MEASURED AND WAS NULL. The Warburg framing in this paper rests on the glycolytic side alone; no mitochondrial endpoint moved.
entries.snippet: Nonetheless, in our study, citrate synthase expression and activity were tested and we did not observe WWOX influence on it.

entries.proposition: THE DISCUSSION ASSERTS A NUCLEAR TRANSLOCATION THAT THE PAPER'S OWN FRACTIONATED BLOT DID NOT DETECT. The blot was positioned to see it and reported no effect; the sentence that survives is the HRE reporter, not the translocation.
entries.snippet: We didn’t observed WWOX influence on HIF1α protein in nuclear fraction.
entries.anchor: Results 2.6.1 Cytoplasmic and Nuclear Distribution of WWOX and HIF1α Proteins

experimental_context.endpoint: HIF1 alpha immunoblot in nuclear and cytoplasmic fractions

entries.proposition: THE PAPER'S CLAIM THAT HIF1A PROTEIN RISES ON WWOX LOSS IS CARRIED BY WHOLE-CELL IMMUNOCYTOCHEMISTRY, AND IT POINTS THE OTHER WAY FROM THE CYTOPLASMIC BLOT IN THE SAME CONDITIONS. Two assays of the same quantity disagree inside one paper, and only one of them is quoted in the Discussion.
entries.snippet: WWOX downregulation resulted in HIF1α increase in normoxia normoglycemia and hyperglycemia condition (both p < 0.01).
entries.anchor: Results 2.7 Immunocytochemistry of WWOX and HIF1α

experimental_context.comparator: scrambled sgRNA control in the same condition
experimental_context.endpoint: total corrected cell fluorescence for HIF1 alpha

entries.proposition: THE PAPER'S OWN THERAPEUTIC LANGUAGE TARGETS WWOX IN DIABETES AND SAYS NOTHING ABOUT THE BRAIN OR ABOUT ANY METABOLIC INTERVENTION.
entries.snippet: However, strategies to normalize glucose metabolism by targeting WWOX may have promise as therapies in the future.

entries.proposition: Figure 5 (knockout arm, hand readings): lactate is higher in the knockout in all four oxygen × glucose conditions (brackets **, ***, ***, **). Pyruvate dehydrogenase activity (5b) shows no knockout-versus-control bracket in any condition; its one bracket joins control normoxia normoglycemia to control normoxia hyperglycemia, a glucose effect. Citrate synthase (5e) carries no within-condition knockout bracket, and its y-axis spans only 1.05-1.25 U/mL. The oxidative arm is measured and unchanged by WWOX loss.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 5, five bar charts (Hexokinase, Pyruvate dehydrogenase, Lactate dehydrogenase, Lactate, Citrate Synthase), white bars 1BR3N CONTR, black bars 1BR3N WWOX KO, four hypoxia × hyperglycemia conditions each.

entries.proposition: One Results sentence calls the Figure 5b activity 'pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase (PDK)'. The figure, its caption and Methods 4.10 all measure pyruvate dehydrogenase. No PDK activity or PDK protein is measured on any surface; PDK appears only as an mRNA (Figure 4, Figure S2).
entries.snippet: while the activities of pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase (PDK) and citrate synthase (CS) were not changed
entries.found_or_sought: found while reconciling the Figure 5b panel title with the text

entries.proposition: The text reports the cytoplasmic HIF1α decrease in two of the four conditions only (normoxia normoglycemia 2-fold, hypoxia normoglycemia nearly 2-fold), and the same paragraph closes: 'One repetition is shown in the Figure 6.'
entries.snippet: the expression of HIF1α protein was significantly decreased in 1BR.3.N WWOX KO in comparison to CONTR in normoxia normoglycemia (2-fold; p < 0.01) and hypoxia normoglycemia (nearly 2-fold; p < 0.001) in cytoplasm fraction
entries.found_or_sought: sought — the HIF1α quantities behind DL-MECH-020

entries.proposition: The supplement (Figures S1-S6) is entirely the overexpression arm: HRE reporter and glucose uptake (S1), qPCR (S2), enzyme activities and lactate (S3), fractionated western blots (S4), glycolytic proteins (S5) and immunocytochemistry (S6). It holds no respiration, ROS, ATP or PDK-protein measurement. The TIFF panels were not rendered; the captions were read.
entries.snippet: Figure S4: WWOX and HIF1α western blot analysis of cytoplasmic (a) and nuclear (b) fractions of WT

entries.proposition: Figure 6a (cytoplasmic fraction, hand readings of fold change): knockout HIF1α about 0.55 versus 1.0 (normoxia normoglycemia) and about 1.25 versus 2.05 (hypoxia normoglycemia) — the two decreases the text reports — about equal in normoxia hyperglycemia (about 0.9 versus 0.9), and higher in hypoxia hyperglycemia (about 2.45 versus 2.1). Nuclear panel 6b has wide error bars; the HIF1α bands are faint. The decrease is condition-specific, not general.
